publications.title: **Gender Abusive Language Detection in Bengali Using Machine Learning Algorithms**
notes: Published - (2nd International Conference on Big Data, IoT and Machine Learning, Springer, 2023)
publications.description: This research focuses on developing machine learning algorithms to detect gender-based abusive language in Bengali text. The study addresses the critical need for automated detection systems to identify and filter harmful content targeting individuals based on gender. The research contributes to creating safer digital communication platforms by implementing effective natural language processing techniques specifically designed for Bengali language patterns and cultural contexts.

publications.title: **Classifying Fake News With A Large-Scale Dataset Using Machine Learning Approaches**
notes: Accepted - (IEEE International Conference on Quantum Photonics, Artificial Intelligence, and Networking, 2025)
publications.description: This comprehensive study presents machine learning approaches for fake news classification using large-scale datasets. The research addresses the growing challenge of misinformation in digital media by developing robust classification algorithms capable of distinguishing between authentic and fabricated news content. The work contributes to combating the spread of false information through advanced computational techniques and comprehensive data analysis methodologies.

publications.title: **Multimodal Deep Learning Approach for Bangla Sign Language Recognition: Integrating Spatial and Geometric Features**
notes: Accepted - (2nd International Conference on Next-Generation Computing, IoT, and Machine Learning, 2025)
publications.description: This innovative research presents a multimodal deep learning framework for Bangla sign language recognition by integrating spatial and geometric features. The study addresses the critical need for accessible communication technologies for the hearing-impaired community in Bangladesh. The work combines computer vision techniques with deep learning architectures to create an effective recognition system that can bridge communication gaps and promote inclusivity in digital interactions.
